Tests that LLM max_concurrency is accepted independently of the extraction thread budget

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val input = mapper.readValue("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/report.txt\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"captioning\":{\"llm\":{\"max_concurrency\":2,\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o\"},\"min_image_area\":1000},\"concurrency\":{\"max_threads\":8},\"url\":{\"crawl\":{\"ssrf\":{}}}}", ExtractionConfig::class.java)
    val result = Xberg.extract(input, config)
    println(result.results.first().mimeType)
    println(result.results.first().content)
}
```
